question_record.context: In a related incident, an alert on 2024-08-01 at 12:49:26 UTC indicated a suspicious credential dump from NTDS.dit, which occurred on host `vnevado-dc`. Attackers dump NTDS.dit in order to obtain user's credentials which are stored in the domain controller.
question_record.question: Can you provide the Process ID and the full command line used in the suspicious credential dump from NTDS.dit related to this incident?
question_record.answer: Process ID: 6748, Command Line: "ntdsutil.exe" "ac i ntds" ifm "create full c:\temp" q q

steps.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT o.AlertId, o.AlertTitle, o.ObservedAt, o.EntityIndex,
       o.GraphValue AS value, o.RawComponents, o.Roles, o.SourceRowHash,
       i.GraphValue AS matched_input
FROM LTMInputEvidence i
JOIN LTMEntityEvidence o ON o.SourceRowHash = i.SourceRowHash
WHERE i.AlertTitle = %s
  AND i.Concept = 'Command_File_Mention' AND o.Concept = 'Process_Identity'
  AND i.GraphValue IN (%s)
ORDER BY o.AlertId, o.SourceRowHash, o.EntityIndex, o.GraphValue, i.GraphValue
LIMIT 501
